title: 在 api/internal/agentrt/store/repos.go 的 Repos 上方补一段注释：说明新增一个仓库要填哪两项（Verify、Test…

out_of_scope: The comment on GoalRepos in api/internal/agentrt/agentrtapi/goals.go (mission M-1).
Adding a repository to Repos or changing any Verify or TestDirs value.
Changing checkTest, planparse.go or any other code.
Editing the comments on Repo, RepoNames, SpecTimeoutS or ImplementSpec.

criteria: The comment directly above `var Repos` in api/internal/agentrt/store/repos.go says that adding a repository means one new entry with two fields: Verify (the commands every implementation task's deterministic check runs, from the repository root) and TestDirs (the module directories in which a plan may add `go -C <dir> test [-run <pattern>] ./<package>` checks, enforced by checkTest).

The same comment says why the default checks are only `go build ./...` and `go vet ./...` and not the full test suite: they run in any fresh agentd checkout, while the full suite needs databases and services that agentd's workspace does not have; a plan proves a specific change by adding targeted `go test` checks in TestDirs instead.
Only that comment changes: the diff touches no code, no other comment and no other file.
`go -C api build ./...` and `go -C api vet ./...` pass.
